Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

born — coming into life. Example: I was born in Rome.
move — to go to live in a new place. Example: I moved to London in 2020.
start — to begin. Example: I started school at six.
finish — to end. Example: I finished school at eighteen.
study — to learn about a subject. Example: I studied history.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I was born in ...
• I started school at ...
• I finished school in ...
• I studied ...
• I moved to ...
